title: Save payment details for returning customers
description:
Context: Returning customers re-enter full card details on every order; checkout for returning customers averages 2m40s. No payment data is stored today.
Reason: Q4 growth goal: +15% conversion for returning customers; payment-data entry is the 3rd-highest drop-off point in funnel analytics.
Scope: Web checkout, cards via the current PSP. Out of scope: native apps, wallets, bank transfers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a returning customer with saved payment details, when they reach checkout, then their saved method is available for selection without re-entering card details.
Given a customer who opts to save payment details, when payment completes, then the details are stored for future checkouts.
Given a saved method used at checkout, when payment completes, then the customer reaches the confirmation page.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
